No build scripts or executable commands are present in this file. The `.SRCINFO` is a declarative metadata file used by AUR helpers and does not execute code. All sources point to the legitimate GitHub repository of the project, and the checksums ensure binary integrity. There is no evidence of tampering, backdoors, or supply-chain attacks.
